The decisive mistake was at step 4. By then the PythonDebugging_Expert had already asked for the missing code at step 2, and nothing had been supplied. Instead of continuing to ask, it invented a hypothetical problem ("assume the code involves language handling") and wrote a made-up `detect_language` snippet. That fabrication replaced the actual task, so the team spent the rest of the run verifying code unrelated to the DHS secretary question. The Verification_Expert's later sign-off at steps 6-9 compounded the error, but it was building on the invented premise that step 4 introduced.
